external_primary_crosschecks.note: arXiv v2 confirms fixed-horizon branch review, rollback of harmful deviations, verifier-passing archive, public code, and improved recovery/query tradeoff over step-level review.
Primary abstract verifies 44.0% MATH-500 vs 28.8% standard AR and the rollback/steering mechanism; worker's depth-table cells remain source-local extraction.
ACL-accepted v6 confirms CMAB strategy adaptation, 9-12% accuracy improvement and 28-35% inference-time reduction under same compute budget.
v2 confirms 0.782 vs 0.796 MATH500, 4,796→2,811 mean tokens (41% reduction), and 76% GSM8K token reduction.
Primary theory confirms VOC/information divergence under simple regret and weighted-A* recovery under an explicit approximation model.
Primary abstract confirms real multimode-fibre platform, Socratic physics critic and positive ablation direction; exact worker-reported sub-bars were not re-extracted.
OpenReview confirms ICML 2026 AI4Math workshop record; exact worker-extracted simulation cells were not independently re-extracted here.
Primary v2 confirms FGGM verified fallback, Search→Verification→Learning and zero constraint violations with improved performance across tested domains.

assessments.rationale: Peer-reviewed method plus official experiment documentation/code make the intended STL-10 label order recoverable, but the released converter remains order-sensitive and the public tree still lacks the precomputed UC8 embeddings needed for exact author-artifact replay.
assessments.tested_scope: Released DriftLens STL-10 same-label blur/domain-shift construction and public code/documentation lineage.
corrections_or_limits: Explicitly impose/verify the documented class order during regeneration.
Missing HDF5/embeddings are a reproducibility gap, not evidence against detector quality.
No independent numerical rerun; standard use-case accuracy is not chronological alarm performance.

assessments.rationale: Primary 2026 theory combines pathwise/adversarial validity under restricted feedback with stochastic efficiency and identifies projection/clipping as breaking the telescoping validity accounting. Rates are theorem-level and model-dependent.
assessments.tested_scope: Online conformal subset/threshold selection under the paper's feedback and stochastic-efficiency assumptions.
corrections_or_limits: Do not universalize O(1/sqrt(T)) tracking or model-specific regret rates.
Boundary fallbacks may be costly; no target-only no-negative-transfer theorem.
Autonomous-research transfer remains a hypothesis.

assessments.rationale: Primary ACS work supports adaptive interactive conformal selection with controlled information exposure and rigorous FDR while allowing partial reuse and updates. Current wave has no independently checked quantitative power effect.
assessments.tested_scope: Adaptive conformal selection under ACS's information-control protocol.
corrections_or_limits: FDR control is not downstream scientific utility or optimality.
Validity depends on the permitted information flow.
No independent numerical replication or exact power-gain crosscheck in this wave.

assessments.rationale: Peer-reviewed best-arm work establishes positive-probability nontermination pathologies despite common high-probability stopping analyses and supplies exponential-tail remedies.
assessments.tested_scope: Fixed-confidence best-arm identification under the paper's wrapper/construction assumptions.
corrections_or_limits: No numeric speedup claim is imported.
Wrapper overhead and base correctness contract remain material.
Transfer requires restartable heterogeneous task state and a meaningful stopping contract.

assessments.rationale: Peer-reviewed defense-specific adaptive attacks drive many tested defenses from low/static ASR to very high ASR, directly showing static/generic evaluation can overstate robustness.
assessments.tested_scope: The named defenses and exact tested attack/threat-model pairs in Nasr et al.
corrections_or_limits: Do not infer identical ASR for untested deployments/variants.
Attacks are defense-adapted rather than one universal transfer attack.
No family-level rejection follows.

assessments.rationale: Matched ICLR evaluation shows adaptive prompt injection eroding trusted-monitor safety and exposes a least-suspicious resampling best-of-n evasion mechanism with a bounded alternative.
assessments.tested_scope: APPS Backdooring/BashBench under the paper's attacker, monitor, budget, thresholds and DTT/DTR variants.
corrections_or_limits: Do not generalize to monitor-independent control.
Resampling backfire is mechanism-specific.
Keep safety cells tied to exact model/benchmark conditions.

assessments.rationale: Large matched email-assistant experiments plus public author code show a defensive fine-tuning configuration increasing delegated actions and reducing attack recognition under contextual manipulation, with adaptive attack and relevant-history control.
assessments.tested_scope: Paper's conditional-delegation email scenarios, tested models, contextual manipulation and adaptive attack.
corrections_or_limits: Threat-model shift does not establish global SecAlign inferiority.
Author code is reproducibility support, not independent replication.
Transfer cells remain version-specific.

assessments.rationale: Primary preprint reports large degradation under high interference but explicitly changes multiple factors together, making it strong evaluation-design evidence rather than clean decoy-only causal evidence.
assessments.tested_scope: Exact none-vs-high-interference configurations and 50-case comparisons in SysEvolve.
corrections_or_limits: Parallelism, decoys, topology hint and ordering co-vary.
Do not assign the full effect to decoys.
Preprint and missing matched factorial limit causal strength.

assessments.rationale: Peer-reviewed UQD work with public code supplies corrected-archive/QD-score-loss diagnostics and matched sampling-budget comparisons showing naive elitism can amplify lucky evaluations while brute-force resampling can starve exploration.
assessments.tested_scope: MAP-Elites-style uncertain QD in the paper's Arm/Hexapod/Walker/Ant domains and uncertainty settings.
corrections_or_limits: Environmental fitness/descriptor noise differs from semantic LLM-judge bias.
M=512 is a measurement budget, not an online prescription.
Aggregate QD-score loss does not separate false-admit from false-reject.

assessments.rationale: e-LOND/stopped e-BH give formal support for online error budgets and, critically, show local anytime-valid processes do not automatically compose under globally adaptive stopping without filtration/causal conditions.
assessments.tested_scope: Online multiple-testing/e-process streams under the respective theorem assumptions.
corrections_or_limits: No theorem proves adaptively generated QD candidates satisfy the required filtration.
FDR does not optimize search regret/diversity.
Archive-controller transfer requires its own proof.

assessments.rationale: Public Loreley artifacts expose a deterministic eligibility and winner rule, making an asymmetric false-admit/false-reject replay exactly specifiable, but the wave still proposes rather than executes the sweep.
assessments.tested_scope: Released Loreley formal records and deterministic eligibility/winner selection layer.
corrections_or_limits: No quantitative corruption-sweep outcome yet.
Eligibility flips are a synthetic decision-layer model.
Public artifacts omit full online generation/archive feedback.

assessments.rationale: The current worker gives an explicit valid P_rho-specific top-up family whose pointwise terminal infimum remains the same exact McNemar test while the induced preterminal lower envelope changes materially. This is a constructive mathematical counterexample to uniqueness, backed by dense-grid numerical sanity checks.
assessments.tested_scope: One-sided nonrandomized exact conditional McNemar terminal test under the iid common-rho null and the worker's explicit top-up family.
corrections_or_limits: The positive interim path is partly created by artificial outcome-independent randomization slack and is not shown decision-optimal.
Dense-grid numerical values support the construction but are not external replication.
Do not infer every composite sequentialization is pathological or that forward betting is universally superior.
assessments.primary_source: Koning & van Meer anytime-valid induction theory + exact McNemar literature + worker construction

assessments.rationale: The paired naive and top-up constructions demonstrate that preserving the same terminal composite test and nominal anytime validity does not determine preterminal resolution/utility; nuisance-family selection is an additional design choice.
assessments.tested_scope: Composite sequentialization of the exact McNemar terminal decision under the stated common-rho model.
corrections_or_limits: This is a measurement-design conclusion, not a rejection of the anytime-validity theorem.
Preterminal utility must be evaluated under the intended stopping policy rather than inferred from terminal equivalence.
No external benchmark replication.

assessments.rationale: The checkpoint reconfirms Hydra's restricted rollback-policy comparison while a bounded search still finds no public code/raw Figure-7 artifact. Checker/checkpoint interval/prompts/sampling are matched, but retry semantics remain part of the compared policy.
assessments.tested_scope: Hydra Figure-7 C++ rollback-policy comparison with Qwen2.5-Coder-32B.
corrections_or_limits: Causal object is the full rollback policy, not pure target ranking.
Do not attribute Hydra's overall headline savings to the selector-only comparison.
No raw Figure-7 samples or public implementation were located in this bounded search.

assessments.rationale: SRC provides a resettable GUI/web-agent rollback substrate with public code and a direct K-horizon ablation: fixed-horizon review improves the recovery/query tradeoff over step-level review, with the worker-extracted K=3 setting outperforming K=1 on success while using fewer teacher queries. ArXiv v2 explicitly states this review-horizon tradeoff and links code.
assessments.tested_scope: WebArena-Infinity/Lite and OSWorld subset in the SRC branch-level imitation framework; K changes review horizon and therefore alarm timing/opportunity.
corrections_or_limits: Not a rollback-target-only causal ablation because changing K also changes when review evidence exists and candidate harmful-suffix length.
Author code strengthens reproducibility but is not independent numerical replication.
Final SFT/collector comparisons also change data-collection strategy and should not be attributed solely to rollback.

assessments.rationale: LPSR reports a strong MATH-500 gain over standard AR and a worker-extracted same-framework rollback-depth ablation where depth 1 exceeds depths 2 and 3, directly refuting a universal 'deeper rollback is safer' rule in this token-level setting.
assessments.tested_scope: 8B LPSR mathematical-reasoning setup; 100-problem validation depth ablation and MATH-500 main evaluation.
corrections_or_limits: Token/KV rollback depth is not historical semantic checkpoint selection in GUI/tool agents.
Detector/steering are domain-calibrated and HumanEval transfer is weak.
Preprint-only evidence; no independent replication identified and many-rollback overhead can be large.

assessments.rationale: Peer-reviewed source has official author code. The current worker extends its fixed-seed corrected-Hamming reproduction across K=90,112,156,178 and finds a low-corruption benefit region that contracts with load, while an instantaneous-softmax control nearly reproduces the Time=10 phase map (Pearson 0.9992 across 40 cell means). Short-time checks show slow dynamics can still help or hurt transiently.
assessments.tested_scope: Official N=20 dynamics on the worker's 50-repetition high-load K grid with corrected hard Hamming metric; instantaneous-softmax matched control; limited K=178 transient timecourse.
corrections_or_limits: Independent worker-local reproduction is not an external independent replication of the published heatmap.
Missing official K=24,46,68,134 columns prevent a full grid claim.
No fixed author seed/raw Figure-4 matrices; do not challenge analytical Lyapunov/fixed-point claims from this numerical audit.
Instantaneous-softmax similarity at Time=10 does not prove slow replicator dynamics are unnecessary for other timescales/initializations.

assessments.rationale: Current public Argus source shows strong semantic/deterministic gates on normal Manager transitions and a cheap holds_stage_authority routing guard, but privileged stage mutation primitives consume no secret/revision-bound one-shot capability. A separate CampaignControlStore repair path demonstrates such a capability pattern is feasible. Existing primary audit corroborates the integrity-versus-authentication distinction.
assessments.tested_scope: Argus public commit 455da6c stage transition, reset/rollback/complete and validator-repair control paths.
corrections_or_limits: No unauthorized live mutation was executed; this is source-level architecture/reachability evidence.
Normal early completion is host-derived rather than copied from model text, narrowing the gap.
Deployment or private host controls outside inspected public code are not ruled out.
Post-write control projection is audit/observability, not pre-write authorization.
assessments.primary_source: microsoft/ArgusAgent public source + primary verification audit

assessments.rationale: OpenProver's public code exposes typed planner actions and per-step run archives containing prompts, token/time/cost fields, worker/tool/Lean outcomes, making planner-level offline transitions reconstructable from reruns. The public repository excludes evaluated runs, so actual action-frequency/outcome statistics are not recoverable without a rerun or separate artifact.
assessments.tested_scope: OpenProver public repository instrumentation at observed commit e200251b and its ProofNet runner/inspection tooling.
corrections_or_limits: Instrumentation availability is not evidence that a learned controller improves proving.
runs/ are gitignored and evaluated trajectories were not found publicly.
Exact benchmark rerun still depends on model/provider and Lean environment.

assessments.rationale: ACL-accepted Meta-Reasoner directly learns a contextual-bandit policy over reasoning strategies and reports 9-12% accuracy gains with 28-35% inference-time reduction under the same compute budget; the worker also extracts controlled ablations favoring compact progress reports and MAB selection over raw-history/direct-LLM selection.
assessments.tested_scope: Game-of-24, TheoremQA, SciBench and related reasoning tasks under the paper's LLM-mediated progress/reward setup.
corrections_or_limits: Not Lean/formal proof search and actions are textual reasoning strategies rather than heterogeneous tool calls.
Progress/reward signals are partly LLM-mediated, limiting calibration claims under verifier distribution shift.
Worker-extracted exact ablation cells were not independently re-extracted in this run; primary abstract confirms overall accuracy/time gains and CMAB mechanism.

assessments.rationale: A 1.5B model learns NoThink/Short/Long as a first-token policy inside GRPO. Across three seeds it retains near-base MATH500 accuracy (0.782 vs 0.796) while cutting mean response length 4,796 to 2,811 tokens (41%), with reported 76% GSM8K token reduction without retraining.
assessments.tested_scope: MATH-trained 1.5B distilled reasoning model with one compute-mode choice at trajectory start; transfer benchmarks as reported.
corrections_or_limits: Compute mode is selected once, not repeatedly as evidence arrives.
No tools, retrieval, verifier feedback, worker spawning or model-tier escalation.
Recent preprint; no independent replication and shaped rewards/token caps are part of the intervention.

assessments.rationale: The theory formalizes internal search as computation allocation and proves that information gain and terminal value of computation coincide only under special losses; under simple regret, information gain can rank computations arbitrarily poorly. This directly warns against buying expensive reasoning actions solely for uncertainty/information gain.
assessments.tested_scope: The paper's terminal computation-allocation models, Bellman characterizations and examples such as bandit pulls/tree expansions.
corrections_or_limits: Theory-only; no Lean or agent empirical evaluation.
Exact VOC is generally intractable, so practical transfer requires approximations and calibration.
Does not assert one acquisition rule is universally optimal.

assessments.rationale: AHOIS evaluates a Socratic physics critic on a real multimode-fibre platform and reports that Socratic interrogation improves physical consistency, hypothesis completeness, uncertainty calibration and plan validity. The worker extracts a four-way critic ablation and question-type utility pattern suggesting solution-withholding causal questioning is materially different from generic review or answer-giving correction.
assessments.tested_scope: AHOIS multimode-fibre scientific-planning/experimentation setup under human safety/correction supervision.
corrections_or_limits: Primary abstract confirms real-platform mechanism and ablation direction, but this run did not independently recover all worker-reported Figure-5d numeric bars/question-type utilities.
Human scientists remain in predefined veto/correction roles; not fully human-free discovery.
Rubric improvements are not independent proof of scientific truth; domain transfer is untested.
Do not generalize solution withholding to defect classes that benefit from direct deterministic correction.

assessments.rationale: Scientific CI/CD explicitly layers anytime-valid paired evidence, global spending/capacity budgets, semantic/domain/provenance verification and rollback. The worker reports matched 200x200-proposal simulations where the full three-gate contract sharply reduces harmful accepted edits and rollback cost versus proxy-only/reusable-holdout/anytime-FDR/spending-only policies.
assessments.tested_scope: Workshop paper's synthetic self-edit proposal streams plus controlled polynomial-selection and synthetic RNA-seq examples.
corrections_or_limits: Key comparative evidence is simulation/controlled synthetic evaluation, not a persistent real LLM skill-bank.
OpenReview record confirms the workshop paper, but exact table cells were not independently re-extracted in this run.
Does not establish global safety or >10-round persistent Keep/Rewrite/Remove behavior.
Statistical, capacity and semantic gates protect different surfaces; do not collapse them into one universal scalar gate.

assessments.rationale: SEVerA wraps generative calls with first-order contracts, deterministic checking and verified fallback, then verifies synthesized agent programs for all parameter values before soft optimization. Primary paper reports zero constraint violations while improving utility on symbolic math and tau^2-bench tool-use tasks relative to unconstrained variants/baselines.
assessments.tested_scope: Dafny, symbolic math synthesis and policy-compliant tau^2-bench agentic tool use under the paper's formalizable hard constraints.
corrections_or_limits: Guarantees apply only to formally specified hard properties, not fuzzy/global task-quality claims.
Adaptive holdout reuse, multiplicity and persistent skill-bank lifecycle are outside scope.
Public repository reportedly says code forthcoming; no executable independent reproduction in this wave.
Preprint rather than independently replicated result.

summary.source_identity_rule: source-qualified/run-stable identity; exact C8 source blobs carried on every assessment
summary.replication_rule: Author code, worker-local reruns, simulations and same-paper artifacts strengthen reproducibility/failure scope but are not external independent numerical replication.
material_high_strength: Adaptive attack failures (USENIX/ICLR) remain direct matched robustness evidence in unchanged C8 source blobs.
SRC adds a public-code GUI/web rollback substrate with a direct review-horizon tradeoff; LPSR adds a same-framework rollback-depth ablation in token reasoning.
The astrocyte-gated candidate now has a broader corrected-Hamming phase map plus an instantaneous-softmax causal control that sharply narrows what is attributable to slow dynamics.
Meta-Reasoner supplies peer-reviewed contextual-bandit strategy-selection evidence; Learning When to Think supplies three-seed adaptive compute-allocation evidence.
SEVerA supplies direct formal-contract guarantees plus agentic utility evaluation under exact hard constraints.
material_holds_or_scope_corrections: Evaluation's composite McNemar construction proves path nonuniqueness but uses artificial top-up randomization and is not an operational optimum.
Hydra still does not isolate rollback target under literally equal retry semantics and has no located public raw Figure-7 artifact.
AHOIS exact critic-ablation bar values/question-type utilities were not independently re-extracted; retain qualitative/real-platform ablation strength without fabricated effect sizes.
Scientific CI/CD's strongest layered-control comparison is simulated/controlled, not a persistent real self-modifying LLM deployment.
OpenProver logging is a strong data substrate but public evaluated runs are absent; it is not itself evidence for a learned controller.
